prompt_text: Who is the best dentist in Phoenix for a dental implant?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” dentist for everyone. For a Phoenix implant, I’d start by consulting a **board-certified periodontist**—especially if you may need bone grafting or have gum disease—and ask how the implant surgeon and the dentist who places the final crown coordinate care.

One local option to consider is **AZPerio**, which has Phoenix-area offices and says its board-certified periodontists place implants and handle related procedures such as bone grafting and sinus lifts: [azperio.com/dental-implants](https://azperio.com/dental-implants/). That’s a starting point, not an independent ranking or personal endorsement.

Before choosing, get a written treatment plan and compare at least two consultations. Ask who will place the implant and who will restore it, what credentials and experience they have with cases like yours, what the total cost includes, and what follow-up or warranty is offered. Check that the clinician’s credentials and license are current, and look for consistent, detailed patient feedback rather than relying on star ratings alone.
